metadata.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK DATASET — This dataset is synthetically generated for rigorous, independent evaluation of belief memory and contradiction detection engines. It does NOT represent measured real-world distribution or production telemetry.
metadata.description: 60 held-out evaluation examples spanning 15 semantic categories with ground truth labels (CONTRADICTION, NO_CONTRADICTION, UNCERTAIN).

examples.memory_a: Apex Aerospace completed Q2 2025 with total revenue of $640M and 14% operating margin.
examples.memory_b: SEC Form 10-Q filing establishes that Apex Aerospace actual Q2 2025 revenue was $510M following restatements.
examples.description: Direct numerical contradiction on identical quarterly revenue attribute.

examples.memory_a: Veritas BioLabs maintains its sole research headquarters in Boston, Massachusetts.
examples.memory_b: Regulatory audit confirms Veritas BioLabs has never maintained facilities in Massachusetts and operates exclusively out of San Diego.
examples.description: Mutually exclusive operational headquarters location.

examples.memory_a: Orion Networks announced that Elena Rostova serves as the sole Chief Executive Officer effective January 2025.
examples.memory_b: Board minutes confirm Marcus Vance was appointed sole Chief Executive Officer in January 2025 with no co-CEO structure.
examples.description: Mutually exclusive executive leadership claim.

examples.memory_a: Sentry Data confirmed that zero customer records were accessed during the server intrusion.
examples.memory_b: Forensic audit report reveals unencrypted database dumps containing 450,000 customer records were exfiltrated during the intrusion.
examples.description: Breach denial contradicted by forensic exfiltration proof.

examples.memory_a: Cobalt Logistics operates 4,200 heavy freight trucks across North America.
examples.memory_b: Cobalt Logistics opened three new regional warehousing hubs in Dallas, Atlanta, and Columbus.
examples.description: Orthogonal business operations: fleet size vs distribution facilities.

examples.memory_a: Aura Pharmaceuticals reported R&D expenditures of $120M in FY2024.
examples.memory_b: Aura Pharmaceuticals employs 350 full-time clinical trial researchers.
examples.description: Compatible financial and staffing attributes.

examples.memory_a: Vanguard Solar completed installation of a 50MW solar farm in Nevada.
examples.memory_b: Vanguard Solar signed a power purchase agreement with the city of Phoenix.
examples.description: Independent project completions in separate jurisdictions.

examples.memory_a: Beacon Cyber achieved SOC2 Type II compliance certification in November 2024.
examples.memory_b: Beacon Cyber appointed Linda Wu as Vice President of Enterprise Sales in December 2024.
examples.description: Compliance status and sales leadership are unrelated non-conflicting facts.

examples.memory_a: Krypton Energy management assured investors that the company maintains zero floating-rate debt exposure.
examples.memory_b: Credit agency report details that $340M of Krypton's outstanding syndicated credit facility adjusts monthly based on SOFR.
examples.description: Zero floating-rate debt contradicted by SOFR-pegged credit facility.

examples.memory_a: Lumina stated that full-year production capacity is completely sold out through 2026 due to unyielding customer demand.
examples.memory_b: Internal supply manifests show Lumina idled two main assembly lines and stockpiled 1.2M unsold panels in third-party warehouses.
examples.description: Claim of 100% sold-out capacity contradicted by idled fabrication lines and surging finished inventory.

examples.memory_a: Zephyr Cloud guarantees all European customer telemetry and prompt data is processed exclusively within EU boundaries under GDPR.
examples.memory_b: Academic paper by Zephyr researchers reveals core generative models were fine-tuned on unanonymized prompt logs routed to GPU clusters in Virginia.
examples.description: Data residency sovereignty guarantee disproven by machine learning training disclosures.

examples.memory_a: Strata Mining reported an exemplary safety record with zero lost-time environmental incidents across all sites in 2024.
examples.memory_b: Department of Environmental Protection issued a cease-and-desist order for an uncontained tailings pond rupture that halted operations for three weeks in August 2024.
examples.description: Zero lost-time environmental incidents refuted by regulatory shutdown order for tailings rupture.

examples.memory_a: Helicon Systems appointed Rachel Adams as Chief Financial Officer on March 1, 2022.
examples.memory_b: Helicon Systems announced Rachel Adams retired as CFO on June 30, 2025, and Thomas Cole was named incoming CFO.
examples.description: Natural temporal succession over a 3-year timeline, not a contradiction.

examples.memory_a: Solstice Battery's pilot manufacturing line yielded 400 cells per week in Q1 2024.
examples.memory_b: Following commercial scale-up, Solstice Battery's Gigafactory achieved 18,000 cells per week in Q3 2025.
examples.description: Legitimate capacity expansion over different developmental phases.

examples.memory_a: Merit Life Sciences leased 25,000 square feet of laboratory space in Cambridge in 2021.
examples.memory_b: In 2025, Merit Life Sciences relocated its headquarters to a newly purchased 80,000 square foot campus in Lexington.
examples.description: Corporate campus expansion and relocation over time.

examples.memory_a: Cortex Robotics Series A funding closed at $12M valuation in 2022.
examples.memory_b: Cortex Robotics completed its Series B round raising $45M at a $220M valuation in 2025.
examples.description: Subsequent financing stages over time.

examples.memory_a: Equinox Financial acquired a 60% controlling equity interest in PayGate UK for $180M.
examples.memory_b: A majority stake of sixty percent in British payments processor PayGate was bought by Equinox Financial for one hundred eighty million dollars.
examples.description: Different linguistic phrasing expressing identical factual information.

examples.memory_a: The FDA granted Breakthrough Device Designation for BioGenix's early pancreatic cancer blood screen.
examples.memory_b: Federal regulators awarded breakthrough status to BioGenix Diagnostics for its liquid biopsy screening test targeting pancreatic tumors.
examples.description: Regulatory approval described with alternative terminology.

examples.memory_a: Vector Dynamics reduced its corporate workforce by 15 percent, affecting approximately 600 workers.
examples.memory_b: Around six hundred employees were laid off at Vector Dynamics as part of a 15% headcount downsizing.
examples.description: Corporate restructuring described via active vs passive syntax.

examples.memory_a: TerraNova Agro entered into a 5-year exclusive distribution agreement with Bunge for South American grain exports.
examples.memory_b: Bunge and TerraNova Agro signed a contract granting Bunge sole distribution rights for grains across South America through 2030.
examples.description: Reciprocal contractual partnership with identical expiration and terms.

examples.memory_a: AeroJet Systems is actively manufacturing hypersonic scramjet propulsion units under DoD Contract FA8650.
examples.memory_b: Department of Defense terminated Contract FA8650 for convenience and AeroJet is no longer producing scramjet propulsion units.
examples.description: Explicit negation of manufacturing status under contract.

examples.memory_a: Nordic Health Group maintains accredited inpatient surgical units at all 12 regional hospital centers.
examples.memory_b: Regional healthcare authority confirmed that 4 of Nordic Health's 12 hospitals do not have accredited inpatient surgical facilities.
examples.description: Universal claim ('all 12') negated by specific counter-instance ('4 do not').

examples.memory_a: Apex Mineral has never conducted deep-sea lithium dredging or applied for seabed exploration concessions.
examples.memory_b: International Seabed Authority public registry lists two active deep-sea exploration concession applications filed by Apex Mineral in the Clarion-Clipperton Zone.
examples.description: Explicit denial ('has never applied') contradicted by regulatory filing.

examples.memory_a: QuantumWave confirmed its core post-quantum encryption library contains zero proprietary dependencies and is 100% open-source.
examples.memory_b: Software bill-of-materials audit reveals the library incorporates proprietary closed-source cryptanalytic binaries licensed from Thales.
examples.description: Zero proprietary dependencies claim negated by embedded closed-source binaries.

examples.memory_a: Starlight reported worldwide box office receipts of $842.3M for its summer blockbuster.
examples.memory_b: Final audited distributor statements report worldwide box office gross of $842.1M.
examples.description: Immaterial difference (0.02% rounding variance) on large quantitative metric.

examples.memory_a: Starlight reported worldwide box office receipts of $842M for its summer blockbuster.
examples.memory_b: Final audited distributor statements report actual worldwide box office gross was only $615M due to overseas currency devaluations.
examples.description: Material quantitative divergence (>26% variance) on same metric.

examples.memory_a: Hydra Marine operating fleet comprises 74 commercial cargo vessels.
examples.memory_b: Maritime registry records show Hydra Marine owns and operates 73 active commercial vessels after a tugboat decommissioning.
examples.description: Small discrete difference consistent with single vessel decommissioning.

examples.memory_a: Hydra Marine operating fleet comprises 74 commercial cargo vessels.
examples.memory_b: Lloyd's List confirms Hydra Marine fleet was downsized to 42 active commercial vessels following lender vessel repossessions.
examples.description: Substantial discrete delta representing material fleet contraction.

examples.memory_a: Paladin Cyber Labs announced it has relocated its global headquarters from Austin, Texas to Zurich, Switzerland.
examples.memory_b: Swiss commercial register confirms Paladin Cyber Labs AG is registered as corporate headquarters in Zurich with no remaining Austin corporate charter.
examples.description: Relocation announcement confirmed by official registry filing.

examples.memory_a: Paladin Cyber Labs operates its main engineering headquarters out of Austin, Texas.
examples.memory_b: Paladin Cyber Labs leadership claims the company has never had physical offices or staff in the state of Texas.
examples.description: Active engineering hub claim contradicted by denial of any Texas presence.

examples.memory_a: Summit Retail Brands closed its flagship retail store on Michigan Avenue in Chicago.
examples.memory_b: Summit Retail Brands opened a new express concept boutique in the Fulton Market district of Chicago.
examples.description: Independent store closures and openings within the same metropolitan market.

examples.memory_a: Summit Retail Brands operates exclusively within the domestic United States with no overseas retail footprint.
examples.memory_b: Summit Retail announced the grand opening of its 12th company-owned department store in Tokyo, Japan.
examples.description: Exclusively domestic claim directly contradicted by operational stores in Japan.

examples.memory_a: Titan Asset Management strategy committee mandated zero allocation to unhedged cryptocurrency assets in Q1 2024.
examples.memory_b: In Q2 2025, Titan Asset Management revised its investment charter to authorize up to 3% allocation to spot Bitcoin ETFs.
examples.description: Evolving investment guidelines across different fiscal years.

examples.memory_a: Titan Asset Management stated in Q2 2025 that it strictly forbids any exposure to spot cryptocurrency under all circumstances.
examples.memory_b: SEC Form 13F for Q2 2025 discloses Titan Asset Management acquired $140M in unhedged spot Bitcoin ETF holdings.
examples.description: Simultaneous claim of strict prohibition contradicted by regulatory disclosure.

examples.memory_a: GreenWave prioritizes 100% recyclable post-consumer plastic in all primary product packaging.
examples.memory_b: GreenWave launched a new line of premium glass beverage containers.
examples.description: Recyclable plastic policy does not preclude glass product packaging.

examples.memory_a: GreenWave claims all consumer packaging across its product lines has been 100% plastic-free since 2023.
examples.memory_b: Supply chain audit shows 40% of GreenWave's 2024 shipments use non-recyclable virgin polyethylene plastic bottles.
examples.description: 100% plastic-free claim directly contradicted by 40% virgin plastic usage.

examples.memory_a: NovaGen Biotherapeutics reported preliminary phase II trial results were deemed promising by the scientific advisory panel.
examples.memory_b: An unverified blog rumor claims NovaGen's trial data was described as 'disappointing' by an anonymous source.
examples.description: Subjective adjectives ('promising' vs 'disappointing') from an anonymous low-reliability rumor.

examples.memory_a: CyberShield Defense stated that customer implementation timelines usually range between 30 and 90 days.
examples.memory_b: Industry analyst note observed that some enterprise clients take several months to complete full system migration.
examples.description: Vague probabilistic estimates ('usually range 30-90 days' vs 'some take several months') are compatible.

examples.memory_a: Apex Capital stated it is exploring potential strategic options regarding its minority interest in Datacore.
examples.memory_b: Leaked internal memo suggests Datacore leadership is considering taking the company private.
examples.description: Exploring strategic options is fully compatible with taking company private.

examples.memory_a: Quantix claims its quantum processor exhibits superior coherence times compared to commercial superconducting qubits.
examples.memory_b: Academic preprint argues that neutral atom qubits face unique scaling hurdles compared to superconducting architectures.
examples.description: Superior coherence time does not contradict facing unique scaling hurdles.

examples.memory_a: Veloce Motors manufactured 14,200 electric vehicles in 2024.
examples.memory_b: Veloce Motors delivered 11,800 vehicles to end customers.
examples.description: Manufactured vehicles vs delivered vehicles represent different stages of inventory distribution.

examples.memory_a: Veloce Motors manufactured 14,200 electric vehicles in 2024.
examples.memory_b: Annual audit establishes total 2024 vehicle production was strictly 8,400 units across all manufacturing lines.
examples.description: Direct numerical contradiction on manufactured vehicle count.

examples.memory_a: Solaris Therapeutics reported positive overall response in trial cohort A.
examples.memory_b: Solaris Therapeutics reported cohort B experienced a 12% adverse event rate.
examples.description: Information about separate trial cohorts A and B are orthogonal.

examples.memory_a: Solaris Therapeutics stated that cohort A achieved an 85% overall response rate with zero dose-limiting toxicities.
examples.memory_b: FDA safety advisory reported cohort A was terminated early after 60% of patients developed dose-limiting hepatotoxicity.
examples.description: Zero toxicity claim contradicted by FDA early trial termination for toxicities.

examples.memory_a: Synergy Logistics reported operating profit of $95M in FY2024 after deducting $30M in tax liabilities.
examples.memory_b: Tax authority notice reveals Synergy Logistics paid zero corporate income tax in 2024 and incurred a $40M operating loss.
examples.description: Multiple interdependent financial facts (profit and taxes) contradicted simultaneously.

examples.memory_a: Delta Payment Network claims 99.99% settlement availability and an average transaction confirmation latency of 400 milliseconds.
examples.memory_b: Federal Reserve audit report establishes Delta experienced 14 major system outages in 2024 with median confirmation delay exceeding 18 seconds.
examples.description: Both availability and latency claims disproven across the multi-metric network.

examples.memory_a: Aegis Semiconductor announced fab utilization reached 92% in Q3 while average selling price for silicon wafers increased 8%.
examples.memory_b: Industry market research confirmed Aegis fab utilization stood at 91.5% with wafer ASP rising approximately 7.8%.
examples.description: Multi-metric corroboration within normal measurement precision.

examples.memory_a: Aegis Semiconductor announced fab utilization reached 92% with wafer prices up 8%.
examples.memory_b: SEC investigation files show Aegis fab utilization collapsed to 44% while the company offered 30% price discounts to liquidate inventory.
examples.description: Both utilization and pricing guidance fundamentally contradicted by enforcement findings.

examples.memory_a: OmniCorp reported that board member Arthur Dent might step down pending personal health evaluations.
examples.memory_b: An unverified rumor on Twitter claims Arthur Dent allegedly resigned yesterday evening.
examples.description: Unverified speculation with conditional markers ('might', 'allegedly'); system should abstain.

examples.memory_a: Preliminary assay results from external collaborators could possibly indicate enhanced sensitivity.
examples.memory_b: Conference chatter suggests researchers are uncertain whether assay sensitivity results are statistically significant.
examples.description: High scientific ambiguity and hedging ('could possibly', 'uncertain'); system should abstain.

examples.memory_a: Stellar Exploration is reportedly considering a potential orbital launch attempt in late Q4 2025 if weather permits.
examples.memory_b: Unconfirmed local reports suggest Stellar may postpone test launch windows until early 2026.
examples.description: Hypothetical future scheduling with low reliability sources; system should abstain.

examples.memory_a: Vortex Energy may explore acquiring offshore wind rights in the North Sea if licensing fees are attractive.
examples.memory_b: Speculation indicates Vortex Energy is evaluating alternate solar assets in southern Spain instead.
examples.description: Early stage conditional exploration across disparate options; system should abstain.

examples.memory_a: MicroTech reported revenue of $0.00 in Q1 2024 as a pre-revenue development stage venture.
examples.memory_b: MicroTech confirmed zero revenue ($0) for Q1 2024 in its SEC Form 10-Q.
examples.description: Zero-value boundary condition without division by zero errors.

examples.memory_a: MicroTech reported revenue of $0.00 in Q1 2024 as a pre-revenue development stage venture.
examples.memory_b: Auditor report discloses MicroTech recognized $4.5M in commercial licensing revenue during Q1 2024.
examples.description: Zero revenue vs positive revenue contradiction.

examples.memory_a: Hyperion holds exactly 1,000,000,000 shares of GlobalTel Corp.
examples.memory_b: Hyperion holds 1.0B shares of GlobalTel Corp according to regulatory filings.
examples.description: Large number formatting: 1,000,000,000 vs 1.0B.

examples.memory_a: Hyperion holds exactly 1,000,000,000 shares of GlobalTel Corp.
examples.memory_b: Official regulatory filing reveals Hyperion sold down its position to 400,000,000 shares.
examples.description: Discrepancy of 600,000,000 shares on held position.

examples.memory_a: Acme Robotics announced it did not decrease its engineering budget in 2024.
examples.memory_b: Acme Robotics increased its engineering research budget by 12% in 2024.
examples.description: Double negation / negative polarity ('did not decrease') is fully consistent with 'increased by 12%'.

examples.memory_a: Acme Robotics announced it did not decrease its engineering budget in 2024.
examples.memory_b: Internal financial ledger confirms Acme slashed its engineering budget by 35% in 2024.
examples.description: Claim of 'did not decrease' contradicted by 35% budget cut.

examples.memory_a: Pacific BioPharma's lead oncology candidate failed to demonstrate inferiority to the current standard of care.
examples.memory_b: Clinical trial results show Pacific's candidate was statistically non-inferior to the standard of care.
examples.description: Complex clinical trial phrasing ('failed to demonstrate inferiority' means 'non-inferior').

examples.memory_a: Pacific BioPharma's lead oncology candidate failed to demonstrate inferiority to the standard of care.
examples.memory_b: FDA advisory panel determined the drug was conclusively inferior to standard of care with lower overall survival and higher toxicity.
examples.description: Claim of failed to demonstrate inferiority contradicted by conclusive finding of inferiority.
